capabilities: build study decks from notes, folders, and selected Markdown tables
study all-visible cards with keyboard, swipe, and shuffle navigation
edit card layouts visually with drag-and-drop blocks and per-table layouts
search every table cell and open the exact matching source row
configure empty-cell handling, images, and per-deck card styling
disambiguation: Not a spaced-repetition scheduler: it has no scoring or statistics and shows every enabled card block at once instead of a front/back reveal.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.6.7 or newer; the UI is localized in 16 languages including RTL support for Arabic. Per the manifest, the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to study or review the content of Markdown tables as flashcards.
summary: Turns Markdown tables into all-visible study cards with decks, a visual layout editor, and search over table cells.
